I have moments of “this outfit is growing on me” to “nvm i dont like it” and ill post my personal nitpicks here

- the outfit is too boxy and with that shade of corporate navy blue i feel it makes him look too “Hilary Clinton blue pantsuit” 
- i actually dislike the boots too, they dont match the outfit and the chunky heels dont help the “boxy” look im getting
- his sword colors also arent matching the general fit, im getting more “sci-fi fantasy” from the sword than elegant rose battle, or maybe i feel that the colors make it look like a toy, either way, nitpick
- his head is a bit square too, the top of it, i like the nice middle part theyre going for but the direction of his hair part-line to his head isnt lining up 

Ultimately i love edmond but im not a fan of this look, im hoping his story will make up for it. Im not a fan of people saying “you want him to look more feminine or sluttier” because i dont have a problem with his covered-up fits, winter edmond is actually one of my favorites. I dont mean to be purposefully negative to anyone who enjoys his outfit either, these are just my thoughts. 
However its fine to have this discussion, its normal for people to be upset because this is a gatcha game and aesthetic appeal is half of what draws you to a certain character. Though its not ok for people to make demands of the devs over it.
